digest_conventions:
Reference numbers recomputed directly from the real-data artifacts of the author's earlier private et prototype.

Read-only over `<et-root>/out` and `<et-root>/data`. Streams every file (no full-tape pandas), so it runs in a few
minutes and well under 1 GB of RAM. Writes one JSON document of aggregate numbers and digests (no event-level rows)
that `validate_et.py` compares queuetruth outputs against.

Usage (runs today, needs only Python 3.11+ and pyarrow):
    python -I et_reference.py --et-root <et checkout> --out expected.json

Digest conventions (validate_et.py renders queuetruth outputs the same way before hashing):
- `bbo_rows_sha256[instrument_id]`: sha256 over the et `bbo.csv` data lines of that instrument, in file order,
  each line exactly `ts_event,instrument_id,bid_px,bid_sz,ask_px,ask_sz,sequence
` (empty side: price
  9223372036854775807, size 0).
- `rank_rows_sha256_relabelled[instrument_id]`: sha256 over et `rank_trace.csv` lines of that instrument in file order,
  with `sweep_id` replaced by the 1-based index of that sweep's first appearance within the instrument's rows.
- `rank_rows_sha256_no_sweep[instrument_id]`: same lines with the `sweep_id` column dropped.
- `depth{N}_rows_sha256[instrument_id]`: sha256 over et `depth.csv` data lines (N levels, et wide layout) per instrument.
- `trades_rows_sha256[instrument_id]`: sha256 over `trades.csv` lines `ts_event,instrument_id,price,size,aggressor_side,sequence
`.
- `shadow_digest`: sha256 over lines `shadow_id,ts_live,ts_first_fill,filled_qty,queue_ahead_at_live,queue_ahead_at_first_fill,reason_class
`
  sorted by shadow_id; empty string for null; reason_class in {queue_depleted, crossed, never}.
- `queue_trace_digest`: sha256 over lines `shadow_id,ts_event,queue_ahead
`, shadows sorted by id, rows in file order.

ingest.expected_data_quality_verdict_note: all et counters are 0; qt verdict should be 'clean' unless qt counts side-N prints (hidden_prints) or off-price executions as warnings

provenance.computation: streamed et mbo.csv / trades.csv: row counts, action counts, F_LAST(128) counts per instrument_id

rank aggregates recomputed from rank_trace.csv rows (histograms 0..5+, sweeps = distinct sweep_id, multi = sweeps with >1 row, buckets = floor((ts-midnight)/1800s), first 60 s = [midnight+34200 s, +60 s)); equal to invariants.json

bbo_full.render: f'{ts_event},{instrument_id},{bid_px or 9223372036854775807},{bid_sz},{ask_px or 9223372036854775807},{ask_sz},{sequence}\n' (bid_sz/ask_sz 0 when the side is empty; counts dropped)
bbo_full.change_rows_note: lower bound for qt bbo='change' row counts: qt also emits a row when only bid_ct/ask_ct changes

provenance.computation: per-instrument sha256 of the raw data lines in file order

rank_trace.render: f'{ts_event},{instrument_id},{sequence},{order_id},{chr(side)},{price},{rank},{rank_sweep_adjusted},{level_depth},{sweep_ix},{exec_kind}\n' where sweep_ix = 1-based first-appearance index of sweep_id within the instrument's rows

shadows_mirror_et.queue_trace_semantics: et emits (ts, queue_ahead) when the value differs from the last emitted value, checked after activation (ts = ts_live) and after every event end while the shadow is still live; the event that fully fills or a cancel that ends the shadow emits nothing

spec_reference.note: predicted by et_shadow_reference.py (independent Python port of SPEC 5.2 / et shadow.rs); per-fill rows exclude behind_volume_executed

real_orders.note: ITCH replace (U) arrives as C + A with a new order reference, so qt sees no Replace effect on Nasdaq; et 'partial' (partly filled, then cancelled) maps to qt end_reason 'cancelled' with filled_qty > 0; queue_ahead_at_add is NOT compared (et's tape queue_ahead differs from the engine level-before-add by design: equal for 99.1% / 99.6% of the sampled orders)

provenance.computation: copied; n_filled cross-checked against shadow_fills.csv (both_filled == n_filled)
copied (et ridge-logistic competing-risk model on real orders, 55/15/30 time split within the day; not the same protocol as RD-10)

depth.render: f'{ts_event},{instrument_id},{sequence}' + ''.join(f',{bpx},{bsz},{apx},{asz}' for level 1..N) + '\n', missing level = 9223372036854775807,0; one row per event
